created: 2026-10-06 Asia/Seoul, before calculating new strategy results
request: 52-week-high nearness alone; no 12-1 momentum, no past directional returns as alpha features; Bayesian return distribution, selective hold/reduce/exit, no mandatory time exit
data: Same adjusted closes, positive volumes, historical KOSPI200 membership, 407 historical stocks through2026-07-31. Earlier results have been inspected; historical research is not pristine OOS. Inputs immutable.
eligibility: Historical membership, positive price/volume,253 valid trailing closes, prior60-day volatility. Same ten-session anomaly quarantine for new buys only. No momentum gate. Near=P/max252close, rank computed among eligible names, deterministic code tie-breaks.
entry_exit: Review every5 sessions, update posterior every day. New names near>=.90 and top10% ranks; incumbents near>=.90 and top20%. Max20 positive target names,8% target stock cap, long-only sum weights<=1, cash0 rate. Membership exclusion triggers next-close exit daily; ordinary near/rank exit at5-day review. If currently untradable, preserve queued exit or re-evaluate on next review; no fill. No fixed maximum holding period. If new rule selected later, do not automatically liquidate existing stocks.
model: Rolling normal-inverse-gamma Bayesian linear regression, standardized simple future return from nextclose s+1 to s+H+1 divided by sigma_s sqrtH. X=[1,z,z^2,rank_centered], z=(near-.90)/.10 clipped[-5,1], rank_centered=2rank-1. Train on eligible near>=.80, no label winsorization. Prior beta|s2~N(0,s2 Lambda0^-1), Lambda0=diag(16,4,4,4); s2~InvGamma(3,2). Per-date power-likelihood weights1/(Ndate*H) reduce cross-sectional and overlapping-return overconfidence but do not model exact dependence; report calibration. Daily rolling posterior is a conditional Bayesian stochastic return model, not a continuous-time diffusion or a fully specified random-walk state model for coefficients.
maturity: At decision t use only labels ending <=t-1. Latest origin s=t-H-2. Rolling W refers to most recent W mature origin dates, not W calendar days. Require126 mature dates. Missing-excluded-price outcomes use assumed100% lastmark recovery; stress this assumption. Costs do not enter gross label training.
grid: H in[5,20], W in[504,1008], posterior expected-positive-net-probability gate in[.60,.75], risk_aversion in[3,10]:16 candidates, freeze before results. H is forecast horizon, NEVER maximum holding period.
probabilities: Report separately P(latent expected H-return > entry roundtrip cost) and P(realized H-return > entry roundtrip cost). Entry uses former with grid threshold, incumbent negative-signal exit if P(latent expected gross H-return>0)<.40. Model probabilities are conditional estimates; test calibration and do not call them guaranteed success rates.
allocation: Maximize mu'w -gamma/2*w Sigma_H w -0.5*w U w - current asymmetric costs relative to pretrade holdings, with 0<=w<=8%, sum<=1. Sigma_H=H*(market factor covariance+idiosyncratic diagonal) estimated using prior returns; risk inputs only, not momentum signal. U is posterior covariance of mean returns. Exact convex composite solver with cash permitted and gap certificate. Already-paid entry cost is sunk. New entry gate includes roundtrip estimate; objective charges only currently planned net trades.
band: Except mandated exits/cap trims, change weights only if absolute difference exceeds max(.005,20% desired weight); skip entire optional change if total estimated utility improvement <=.00005 NAV. Enforce stock cap before band and prevent increases during no-entry review. Buy cash scaling at next close; actual weights may drift above8% between reviews.
